tagline: Turn robot recording metadata into a useful quality review.
introduction: A robotics-data companion informed by Qualia's public work on understanding recordings, task episodes and quality signals.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Qualia? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Define an episode schema
capabilities.description: Describe useful metadata for reviewing robot task recordings.

capabilities.title: Create a quality rubric
capabilities.description: Define transparent quality criteria for a supplied robotics task.

capabilities.title: Review supplied annotations
capabilities.description: Review declared frame/timestamp continuity, annotation references and consent scope; the optional local fictional checker never authenticates recordings, consent or success.

starterPrompts: Design an episode metadata schema for a robot pick-and-place recording with explicit success evidence.
Create a review rubric for pick-and-place episodes that explains why a clip might be unsuitable.
Review these episode annotations and flag labels that lack evidence.
